name: Bodyweight glute bridge
definition: Lie on the back with knees bent and both feet on the floor. Raise the pelvis by extending the hips, then lower it back to the floor.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Lie on the back with knees bent and both feet on the floor.
value.movement: Raise the pelvis by extending the hips, then lower it back to the floor.
value.finish: Return to the original supine position.
value.range_of_motion: Floor-to-bridge and return; no external resistance or elevated support.
